Excellent food
Jul 2025 • Friends
I had an amazing experience at Today With You in Thao Dien. The food was absolutely delicious — fresh ingredients, beautiful presentation, and full of flavor. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, perfect for catching up with friends. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made sure we were well taken care of throughout the meal. I especially loved the variety on the menu; there’s something for everyone. Whether you’re going for a casual lunch or a relaxed dinner, this place won’t disappoint. I highly recommend it to anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City. I’ll definitely be coming back!
